title: Copilot PR CI retry: GitHub-managed dynamic workflow runs are excluded before pending and budget checks
answers: Why are all scheduled CI retries skipped on a Copilot PR with the message 'workflows are pending or in progress'?
Why does a failed Copilot code review run keep a commit from being retried?
Where does the retry script filter out Copilot agent or review runs?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites is the check-suite rollup that feeds both the pending-state check and the retry-budget check for a PR head commit; it runs for every Copilot PR selected by retry.yml.
Rule: GitHub-managed runs (Copilot agent and Copilot review, which use the github-actions app with workflowRun.event == 'dynamic') are dropped with select(.workflowRun.event != "dynamic") before group_by/max_by, so they neither block retries while pending nor count as rerunnable failures.
Rule: ordinary pending github-actions runs still block the whole commit; only the dynamic event is exempt.
Symptom: on Copilot PRs, every scheduled attempt was skipped while a dynamic Copilot run was pending, or each attempt failed because a dynamic run stayed failed and was treated as rerunnable CI.
Constraints: applies to the github-actions app's check suites on a commit; a new non-dynamic event type will still be treated as ordinary CI.
applies: Any filter over check suites or workflow runs used for reruns, pending detection, or retry budgets in this repo.
says: Pull request build retries are blocked because automated code review is still running.
Why does a failed automated review check prevent our test suite from being retried?
Scheduled retries say workflows are in progress when only the automated reviewer is running.
Prevent ongoing automated review runs from pausing automatic retries of failed pull request builds.
A failed code review check is consuming our retry attempts for pull request builds.
search: In .github/workflows/retry.sh:suites, GitHub-managed runs with workflowRun.event == 'dynamic' are excluded via select(.workflowRun.event != 'dynamic') before pending-state and retry-budget evaluations. Excluding Copilot agent and review dynamic runs ensures they neither block scheduled retries while pending nor consume retry budget when failed. Ordinary pending github-actions runs continue to block the commit. This applies to check suites evaluated for reruns, pending detection, and retry budgets on Copilot PRs.
